sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Cool Cubes IO are straightforward: players control a cube trying to outmaneuver and eliminate other cubes in its vicinity. To achieve this, players can spawn triangles by clicking on their cube, which can then be used to attack and destroy other cubes. The player's goal is to be the last cube standing, and the game ends when only one cube remains. This simple concept may seem trivial at first, but it's the game's depth and complexity that make it so engaging.

As players progress through the game, they'll discover that Cool Cubes IO has a few key mechanics that add depth to the gameplay. For example, players can use their triangles to block incoming attacks from other cubes, or they can use them to attack multiple cubes at once. Additionally, the game features a variety of different cube skins, each with its own strengths and weaknesses. Players can choose from a range of skins, from fast and agile cubes to slow and tanky ones. This adds a layer of strategy to the game, as players need to choose the right skin for the situation and adapt to changing circumstances.

The game's physics engine also adds to the gameplay experience, as players need to take into account the movement and trajectory of their triangles and other cubes. This requires a combination of timing and spatial awareness, making the game challenging and rewarding to play. As players master the core gameplay mechanics, they'll discover that Cool Cubes IO is a game that requires skill, strategy, and a bit of luck.
